reviewScope: Manila Bay (Cavite-side project-area fisheries context only); no individual locality or waterbody attribution.

sourceReview.title: Proposed Cavite Province Land Reclamation and Development Project: Island C (205 hectares) — Environmental Impact Statement
sourceReview.publisher: Environmental Management Bureau, DENR; proponent: Cavite Provincial Government

projectAsDescribed.name: Cavite Province Land Reclamation and Development Project: Island C
projectAsDescribed.reportedLocation: Along the coastal waters of Noveleta, within the jurisdiction of Cavite Province.
projectAsDescribed.statusScope: The EIS and public-hearing notice describe a proposed project in 2021. Current implementation or approval status was not reviewed.

sourceReview.access: Official EMB PDF downloaded over HTTPS (HTTP 200, application/pdf), SHA-256 recorded, and pages containing Table 2.2-46 inspected directly. Temporary PDF copy deleted after review; no source file retained.
sourceReview.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and the table caption only. No item-specific reuse license or permission to reproduce the table was verified.

fisheriesLead.table: Table 2.2-46, “List of Fish Species Caught in Fishing Grounds of Rosario, Noveleta, and Cavite City”.
fisheriesLead.basis: The title appears in the official EIS table of contents.
fisheriesLead.interpretation: Direct inspection confirms a 17-row table: 15 fish-labeled rows and two invertebrate rows. Its title groups fishing grounds of Rosario, Noveleta, and Cavite City near the proposed project; no row is assigned to an individual municipality, site, or waterbody. The project is described on Manila Bay’s Cavite coast, so retain the source only as broad historical Manila Bay context.

decision.action: Assign the EIS as broad historical fishery context to the Manila Bay regional lead; do not attach individual taxa to municipalities, sites, or exact waterbodies.
reasons: The table caption groups fishing grounds across Rosario, Noveleta, and Cavite City; item-level sampling locations and rows were not reviewed.
The 205 ha figure is a proposed reclamation project area, not an aquatic habitat boundary, fish sampling area, or waterbody geometry.
A 2021 EIS does not establish present-day occurrence, abundance, catchability, safety, legality, or diet.
Direct PDF review confirmed the table body, but it does not supply row-level locality assignments. Its project-area setting supports only a broad Manila Bay context.

nextResearch: Verify item-specific rights or obtain permission before retaining or publishing any table-derived species names.
If rights permit, resolve every source label against authoritative fish and invertebrate taxonomy while preserving genus-only source ranks and source spellings.
Seek source material that maps catches to individual fishing grounds before adding municipality- or site-level occurrence claims.
Do not treat the 2021 proposed-project EIS as current fishing conditions, a complete bay checklist, or legal/safety advice.
